A heartfelt tribute

Honouring 26 years of dedication.

Some achievements are measured in years. The most meaningful are measured in the commitment, care, and integrity brought to every one of them.

Today, we celebrate Gunanand Sharma, Executive Engineer, and twenty-six years of dedicated service. It is a moment to recognise a significant professional chapter, to reflect with pride on the journey so far, and to offer our heartfelt appreciation for the years of work and responsibility behind it.

Retirement is not simply an ending. It is the beginning of a new season—with more time for family, treasured friendships, long-held plans, peaceful mornings, and adventures still waiting to unfold.

May this next chapter bring good health, happiness, meaningful discoveries, and countless moments worth remembering. Surrounded by the people who matter most, we raise a glass to all that has been accomplished—and to all the wonderful things yet to come.

26 years of service · A lifetime of memories
With respect, gratitude and warmest wishes
